narr: Isolated storms developed in an area where dewpoints in the low to mid 70s pooled. There was some weak surface convergence, ML CAPEs over 2000 J/kg, and steep low-level lapse rates, so there were some localized damaging microbursts with the severe storms. An area of storms over northern St. Clair County in Illinois produced up to 5 inches of rain in about a two hour period with some reports of flash flooding.
ev: Up to four inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding. Highway WW was underwater near the intersection with El Chaparral Avenue. A water rescue was performed in this area after a vehicle drove into the flooded roadway. No injuries were reported.
lsr: Highway WW near El Chaparrel underwater with a water rescue by fire department.
